description: A Tree expander that turns the Tree beside it into a melody; it goes immediately to the right of a Tree module

params.text: Sets the level the Tree's first output has to reach for a step to sound, read across -5V to +5V
Attenuverts the threshold input before it is added to the threshold knob

inputs.text: Shifts the threshold, volt for volt at full attenuverter

outputs.text: A gate or a trigger for each step whose value passed the threshold, 10V while it is on
The Tree's second output taken as the note pitch, rescaled into the range chosen on the menu
The Tree's third output, held until the next step that sounds
The Tree's fourth output, held until the next step that sounds
The Tree's fifth output, held until the next step that sounds

notes: this does nothing unless a Tree module is placed immediately to its left, and it steps on the clock that Tree is given rather than on one of its own.
only one note sounds at a time. The polyphony setting spreads successive notes across channels; it does not play chords.
a step whose value does not reach the threshold leaves the pitch and the three CV outputs holding what the last sounding step put there.
menu: Gate: Trigger, Gate — sets whether the gate output gives a short pulse on each note or stays high until the next one
Range: +/-10V, +/-5V, +/-3V, +/-2V, +/-1V, +10V, +5V, +3V, +2V, +1V — sets the voltage range the pitch output is rescaled into
Polyphony — sets how many channels the outputs carry, 1 to 16; successive notes are written to successive channels so an envelope can finish the last note while the next one starts
